scripts.apps:add: bun run api:add & bun run event-stream:add & bun run notification:add & bun run web:add && wait
scripts.dev: bun run api:dev & bun run event-stream:dev & bun run notification:dev & bun run web:dev
scripts.preview: bun run api:preview & bun run event-stream:preview & bun run notification:preview & bun run web:preview
scripts.api:preview: cd apps/api && bun run build && bun run prod
scripts.event-stream:preview: cd apps/event-stream && bun run build && bun run prod
scripts.notification:preview: cd apps/notification && bun run build && bun run prod
scripts.web:preview: cd apps/frontend && bun run build && bun run preview
scripts.docker: docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d
